artifacts.summary: Fixed the H4 shape-based adversarial-table matcher (Defect A) and wired both terminal exit paths through a new shared completion-propagation helper (Defect B) in skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md.

completion_data.completion_summary: Replaced the literal-string H4 adversarial-table grep with a verified shape regex tolerant of both known claim-table header formats, and added a shared hard_orchestrate_propagate_completion() helper wired into both the skeleton-exhaustion exit and the Stage 5 implemented tail so completion_summary/roadmap_items are always propagated from .return-meta.json. All changes confined to agent-system/extensions/core/skills/skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md.

memory_candidates.content: For a fixed-header-string grep gate that needs to tolerate header variants (extra columns, reordered prefix words), replace with a case-/spacing-insensitive shape regex like `grep -qiE '\|[^|]*\bWORD1\b[^|]*\|[^|]*\bWORD2\b[^|]*\bWORD3\b[^|]*\|'` matching adjacent table cells by content rather than exact header text. Always verify against the real grep binary by absolute path (e.g. /run/current-system/sw/bin/grep) when the interactive shell's `grep` alias may resolve to a differently-behaving wrapper (e.g. ugrep).

When multiple terminal exit paths in an orchestration state-machine skill need identical follow-up logic (e.g. propagating completion_summary/roadmap_items from .return-meta.json), extract one named helper function taking an optional precomputed-JSON parameter, rather than inlining the same block at each exit site. This both prevents omission at new exit paths and preserves a 'single reader of the source file per cycle' invariant when one call site already has the data cached.
